controles.affirmation: Plainte derivee Brewer v. Turner (Delaware Chancery, 22 dec 2023) liee au Consent Order CFPB de sept 2022 ; rejet partiel sept 2025 ; appel rejete par la Cour supreme du Delaware le 15 dec 2025 ; SLC ; sursis prolonge jusqu'au 2 novembre 2026 ; pas d'effet significatif attendu
controles.verbatim_source: On December 22, 2023, a putative shareholder derivative complaint was filed in the Court of Chancery of the State of Delaware, captioned Brewer v. Turner [...] against a number of Regions' current and former directors and officers. The claims [...] relate to the subject matter of the previously disclosed Consent Order that Regions entered into with the CFPB in September 2022. In September 2025, the court issued an order granting in part, and denying in part, the defendants' motion to dismiss. The defendants appealed [...] which appeal was denied on December 15, 2025. Regions' Board of Directors has established a Special Litigation Committee [...] the court granted an order on February 5, 2026 staying the action for 180 days, and, by order dated July 17, 2026, the court extended the stay through November 2, 2026.

controles.affirmation: Le Consumer Bank est le segment le plus gros contributeur en volume de depots ET de prets
controles.verbatim_source: Depots au 31/12/2025: Consumer Bank segment $80,193 / Corporate Bank segment 40,449 (10-K FY2025). Mais prets au 30/06/2026: Total commercial $57,235 + Total investor real estate $9,969 = 67,2 Mds$ (Corporate Bank) contre Total consumer $31,996 (10-Q T2 2026). Actifs moyens T2 2026: Corporate Bank $73,240 contre Consumer Bank $36,658.
controles.correction_proposee: Vrai pour les depots, faux pour les prets. Le Corporate Bank porte environ deux fois plus de prets et d'actifs moyens que le Consumer Bank. Reformuler: 'le segment qui collecte le plus de depots est aussi celui qui recule' et supprimer 'et de prets'.
